snippet.title: Signal Veil - World Premiere Trailer | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Signal Veil is a classic-style survival horror game coming to PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2.

After inheriting her mother’s old phone, Aki begins experiencing supernatural phenomena that no one else can see. As her seemingly ordinary school reveals a disturbing past buried beneath false memories and silence, she must confront grotesque spirits, impossible messages, and a fractured reality.

Explore tense environments through classic fixed camera angles, use Aki’s phone to detect supernatural entities and reveal what cannot normally be seen, and survive with limited resources and tactical combat.--
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
